why: Found by the lead at I116's landing (claude/ci-i116-landing), on the landing tree's run of the CI job tests-m6-i115, after I116's measured runs; the test is I115's, not one of I116's predictions, and no score moves (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says the protocols before I115 name none of I115's opt-ins (run_unbound, bind, preflight_go). It globbed every spec/M6/lib/i1*_run.json except i115_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I116's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i116_run.json) carries I115's landed opt-ins by its protocol amendment 1c24100e and fails it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check skips the protocols of I115 and later keys (an iteration number of 115 or more, read from the protocol's own iteration field), the same change I117's prereg makes on its branch. The protocols it was written for, and the assertion, are unchanged.
